summary: Iter 34 — Full regression on (A) httpOnly cookie auth migration and (B) Customer Display Uni5Pay branding + bank-details + live sync. ALL 10 test items PASS. 6/6 backend pytest cases green; 4/4 frontend UI checks green (cd-root, red/green QR border, Uni5Pay logo, bank tile, swap-card, cookie persistence). The live-sync push pipeline (operator PUT → public GET → customer screen) confirmed working via API+UI polling (customer screen re-rendered within ~2s on every PUT, console logs 'customer-display update via poll').
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerDisplay.jsx is 838 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit. Idle/Greet/Overview/Pay/MethodPick/Receipt/Picker are all in one file. Consider splitting into ./customer-display/{Idle,Greet,Overview,Pay,Method,Receipt,Picker}.jsx with a shared CustomerDisplay.jsx orchestrator for maintainability (low priority — not blocking).

Backend cookie helper _set_access_cookie reads COOKIE_SECURE env (default 1). backend/.env does NOT explicitly set COOKIE_SECURE — relies on default. For production traceability, recommend adding 'COOKIE_SECURE=1' explicitly to .env so the security posture is configuration-visible.

Auth login response body still includes access_token in JSON body (for Bearer fallback) — this is intentional per spec for legacy PWA clients. Once all PWA clients are migrated, this should be removed to fully realise the XSS-hardening goal. Current implementation is correct backwards-compatibility step.
test_credentials: admin@vastgoed.sr / admin123 ✓ — login redirects to /surirent/admin, cookie persists across reload, /api/auth/me returns 200 from cookie only and from Bearer-only fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie flags confirmed: HttpOnly=True, Secure=True, SameSite=Lax. Login body still includes access_token (Bearer fallback). Logout clears all 3 cookies (access_token, kiosk_token, tenant_token) with Max-Age=0. Public CD endpoint /api/public/customer-display/<slug> now exposes bank_account_sr + bank_account_nl in branding. CustomerDisplay.jsx MethodScreen renders red/emerald ring on cd-method-mope based on amt>0, with 'WACHT OP BEDRAG' / 'KLAAR OM TE SCANNEN' badge. Bank tile shows inline 'SR:' and 'NL:' lines. When operator picks bank, the right column swaps to cd-bank-details-card (prominent amber). Customer screen polls /api/public/customer-display every ~1.5s (console: 'update via poll'), so changes from operator PUTs appear within 2s.
